features.title: Resume a goal after a provider refusal
features.summary: Arm a thread from the composer; when a goal round fails on a quota, rate limit or account error, the Host resumes the goal after the reset the provider announced plus a margin.

configuration.constraints: Integer from 1 to 50; further refusals leave the goal paused.

failureModes: A refusal that carries no wait backs off from 5 minutes, doubling to the ceiling.
A human turn that fails is never retried: only a goal round counts.
A goal that is gone, complete or out of rounds marks the retry failed and stays paused with a reason.
A human resume by hand drops the pending retry instead of racing it.

verification.testName: follows the announced reset plus the margin
stops resuming after the configured attempts

onboarding.firstAction: Open the alarm chip beside Send in a thread that has a goal.
onboarding.doneWhen: The chip stays lit and the goal resumes by itself after the next usage limit.

telemetry.reason: Reads the goal service and an in-memory timer; it performs no I/O of its own and its resumes appear in the goal change stream.
